# SYNK

> SYNK develops personalized systems rooted in understanding each person's needs and possibilities, connecting advances in AI to learning, work, and culture.
> LAB researches paths for learning and experience aligned with a person's life direction. Korean-language education for Mongolian learners is currently in preparation.
> SHIFT connects individuals and organizations through institutional education, business consulting, branding and advertising, and study-abroad and employment pathways. Service availability and partnerships require individual confirmation. Its public AI company-building work demonstrates methods and judgment.
> PULSE creates music, video, characters, and stories that deepen enjoyment, emotion, and shared memories. Appreciation of a work has value in itself.

The Korean-language corporate homepage introduces the shared philosophy, each brand’s purpose and current scope, and SYNK’s own brand design. Public-document questions are answered locally from authored passages. It does not send questions to a server, accept applications, or conclude contracts. Planned services and confirmed availability are distinct; no course, qualification, institutional partnership, or outcome guarantee should be inferred.

<!-- SYNK PUBLIC VISIONS START -->
## 비전

### SYNK

저마다의 삶을 온전히 누리는 미래를 만듭니다.

AI가 넓힌 가능성을 배움과 일, 문화로 연결합니다.

### SYNK LAB

가고 싶은 방향에 집중할 수 있는 환경을 만듭니다.

### SYNK SHIFT

개인과 조직의 성장이 서로의 기회가 되는 미래를 만듭니다.

국경과 환경을 넘어, 개인은 역량을 펼칠 무대를 만나고 조직은 준비된 인재와 함께 성장하는 세상을 지향합니다.

### SYNK PULSE

함께한 시간이, 각자의 이야기로 이어지는 문화를 만듭니다.

비전은 각 브랜드가 지향하는 미래이며, 현재 제공·준비 상태와 이용 조건은 공개 안내에서 따로 확인합니다.
<!-- SYNK PUBLIC VISIONS END -->
